Lukas "gla1ve" Rossander (born June 7, 1995) is a Danish professional Counter-Strike 2 coach and former professional Counter-Strike 2, Counter-Strike: Global Offensive and Counter-Strike: Source player. He is one of the most accomplished in-game leaders in Global Offensive, having led Astralis to four record-breaking Major victories.

gla1ve was a member of the legendary Astralis lineup from 2018 to 2020, winning 19 S-Tier tournaments as a player across his career, including four Major championships and an ESL Grand Slam.

Trivia

[edit]
  • Suffered a pneumothorax (collapsed lung) only hours before his team's semi-final against ENCE eSports at Assembly Winter 2016 and proceeded to play the game nonetheless, despite having Patrik "es3tag" Hansen from Epiphany Bolt ready to step in for him. [1]
  • Was ranked the 8th best player of 2018 by HLTV. [2]
  • Was named the MVP of IEM Season XIV - Beijing by HLTV. [3]
  • 2nd most Majors won (4).
    • Tied with dev1ce, Xyp9x, Magisk, and apEX.
